# lil' bird coaching

> Life and leadership coaching with Luke Haythorpe (GiANT Worldwide certified) for people in transition: career change, identity, and lives that look fine on paper but don't feel like theirs. In person in the San Francisco Bay Area and Melbourne, and online worldwide.

## Coaching
- [First Flight](https://lilbird.life/first-flight/book.html): a 90-minute one-to-one intro session. Your story mapped, the real issue named, one next move. $299, or $149 with code IMREADY.
- [Coaching session](https://lilbird.life/coaching/book.html): an ad hoc 45-minute session when something specific needs working through. $249.
- [Life Change Intensive](https://lilbird.life/intensive/): eight in-person coaching sessions with Luke. $4,999.
- [Free discovery call](https://lilbird.life/book.html): a short call to see whether coaching is a fit.
- [How sessions work](https://lilbird.life/format.html): what happens in a session, and the options side by side.

## Self-guided
- [Inner Compass](https://lilbird.life/inner-compass/): a guided personality read (MBTI, Enneagram, attachment) plus a Life Canvas of where you are now. Free first look; full read and Nest $2.
- [Life Change Sessions: Solo](https://lilbird.life/solo/): the eight-session course at your own pace, with tools and an AI guide trained on how Luke coaches. $197.
- [Life Change Sessions workbook](https://lilbird.life/workbook/): all eight sessions as an interactive workbook, online or as a PDF. $27.
- [Am I ready for coaching?](https://lilbird.life/am-i-ready-for-coaching.html): a short quiz.
